issue.title: test_blocked_render_with_young_index_lock_is_bounded fails under loaded check lane, passes isolated
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/agents_sync/test_commit_publication_bounded_drain.py::test_blocked_render_with_young_index_lock_is_bounded`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` (scoped lane, `pytest -n 14 --dist=worksteal`)

Fail: 1 failed, 63678 passed in the `sase tool run check` run
`fb24d94391609bb349dc0b6c9edf1ef9` (test (scoped) 15m40s). The node
fault-injects a fresh sidecar `.git/index.lock` before a 30s blocked render and
asserts cleanup stays under budget; its own comment notes a CPU-starved runner
stretches the owner `/proc`-walk probe past the budget. Host load hit
`load1=133` during the run. Triage verdict: 1 NEW, possible owner sase-xo.
Pass: same node on the unchanged tree in isolation:
`1 passed in 6.30s` (serial, unloaded). Does not reproduce serially; parallel
only, under broad-lane load. Same load-sensitive bounded-drain family as
sase-xo/sase-1us, different node, so filed separately per the do-not-conflate
precedent.
